data.title: Income tax assessment 2024: €1,236 to pay
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbach issued the 2024 income tax assessment dated 31 December 2025. It shows an additional payment of €1,236.00 due on 5 February 2026.
data.explanation: Your 2024 tax was set at €15,130.00. Wage tax already withheld was €13,894.00, so you owe the difference of €1,236.00. Pay it to the tax office account by 5 February 2026, using your tax number as the payment reference. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person; the app shows until when. Check the figures against your own records. A tax adviser can help if unsure.
data.tax_note: This is the assessment for your 2024 income tax return. It also confirms that craftsman services (§ 35a EStG) were accepted.

items.title: Pay additional income tax 2024
items.action: Transfer €1,236.00 to the tax office account with your tax number as the reference.

items.title: Deadline to object (Einspruch)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: File an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterbach if you disagree with the assessment.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final.
